sanskrit:
न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम् ।
भूतभृन्न च भूतस्थो ममात्मा भूतभावनः ॥ ९-५॥
iast:
na ca matsthāni bhūtāni paśya me yogamaiśvaram
bhūtabhṛnna ca bhūtastho mamātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ 9-5
translation: Nor do beings exist (in reality) in Me — behold My Divine YOGA supporting all beings, but not dwelling in them, am I My Self, the efficient-cause of all beings.
